task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move CAR to BOX_TOP position, pick BOX_TOP and place it on TEMP_TABLE, then move to BOX_MIDDLE position, pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, finally move back to TEMP_TABLE, pick BOX_TOP and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack with only middle box removed.
assumptions: CAR robot starts at (0, 0) and can navigate to all required positions
BOX_TOP is at (2, -1) and is the top of the stack, so it must be moved first to access BOX_MIDDLE
BOX_MIDDLE is at (2, -1) and is supported by BOX_BOTTOM
BOX_BOTTOM is at (2, -1) and remains in place
TEMP_TABLE at (-2.2, -1.8) is used as temporary storage for BOX_TOP
INSPECTION_TABLE at (-2.2, 2.0) is the destination for BOX_MIDDLE
interaction_distance of 2.0 allows CAR to interact with objects when nearby
After removing BOX_TOP and BOX_MIDDLE, BOX_TOP will be placed back on BOX_BOTTOM
rtdl: def task RemoveMiddleBoxToInspection(;){ state nav_success: bool; state nav_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); retry(3) do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=-1.8,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); retry(3) do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP",location_name="TEMP_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); retry(3) do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); retry(3) do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_MIDDLE",location_name="INSPECTION_TABLE";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-2.2,y=-1.8,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); retry(3) do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP";success->pick_success,message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=-1.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_success,message->nav_msg); check(nav_success == true); retry(3) do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="BOX_TOP",location_name="BOX_BOTTOM";success->place_success,message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
